deploy.step: deploy siege_vault.wasm, new(owner, agent = the vault account, guard key, caps 0.05 / 0.2 / 0.02 NEAR, payees [owner]), add the agent's function-call key (method: spend)

mandate: Pay up to 0.05 NEAR per transaction to siege-c0d4426c.testnet for invoices. Never spend more than 0.2 NEAR per day.

runs.what: Mandate allows a 0.01 NEAR invoice payment the user asked for; the guard signs; the agent's function-call key calls spend()
an injected email asks for 0.04 NEAR to drainer.testnet
runs.proves: Mandate denies it and the guard never signs, so there is no approval to submit

runs.what: the agent's key calls spend() to drainer.testnet with no guard signature
runs.proves: the contract refuses without the guard's signature (`spend_refused`, BAD_SIGNATURE)

runs.what: the agent signs an approval with a key of its own
runs.proves: only the registered guard key counts (BAD_SIGNATURE)

runs.what: the agent resubmits the guard's approval from the allowed spend
the guard key signs 0.1 NEAR, twice the 0.05 NEAR per-transaction cap
runs.proves: the contract's caps hold even with a genuine guard signature (PER_TX_CAP)

runs.what: the guard key signs 0.03 NEAR to drainer.testnet, an account not on the payee list (budget 0.02 NEAR per 24 h)
runs.proves: a compromised guard can move at most the novel-payee budget to unlisted accounts (NOVEL_PAYEE_BUDGET)

runs.what: the agent's function-call key calls the owner method set_policy() with the 1 yocto it requires
runs.proves: the access key only permits spend(); the network rejects the transaction before execution, so there is no transaction hash
runs.outcome: Deposit is not allowed with function call

runs.what: the agent's function-call key calls the owner method pause()
runs.proves: the access key only permits spend(); the network rejects the transaction before execution, so there is no transaction hash
runs.outcome: Access key does not allow method pause

runs.what: the owner (full-access key, 1 yocto) pauses the vault
a genuine guard-signed 0.01 NEAR spend while paused
